accepted_services.organizer: Emmaus Åland r.f.; referrals and needs assessment by professional social workers and partner agencies
coverage_verified: All 16 Åland municipalities as a regional programme; individual access is referral-based

accepted_services.name: Kommunernas socialtjänst (KST) – grundläggande, kompletterande och förebyggande utkomststöd
accepted_services.location: KST, Skarpansvägen 30, Mariehamn; applications and service cover all Åland municipalities.
accepted_services.regular_time: Ongoing statutory application service; apply by KST e-service or paper application. No fixed walk-in schedule confirmed in the current 2026 source.
accepted_services.free_and_conditions: Financial assistance for individuals and families whose income and assets do not cover necessary expenses. Last-resort support: primary benefits such as housing benefit, unemployment benefits, pensions or sickness benefits must normally be applied for first. Support can cover basic living costs and necessary housing expenses including rent-related costs, household electricity and home insurance. It is a benefit, not a paid service; individual assessment applies.

accepted_services.name: Ålands diakonifond
accepted_services.organizer: Jomala församling administers the island-wide fund together with the local parishes
coverage_verified: All 16 Åland municipalities through the seven parish areas
accepted_services.location: Applications are made through the local parish diaconal worker; there is no single client-facing collection point.
accepted_services.regular_time: Ongoing; the local diaconal worker assesses the situation with the applicant. The diaconal team processes applications, normally in about two weeks. No fixed application hours; contact the local parish.

A private individual cannot apply directly to the fund: a parish diaconal worker assesses whether the parish can help from its own resources or submit an application to the fund. No fee or repayment requirement is stated.
accepted_services.contact: Jomala parish diaconia: Ann-Lis Biström 018 328 313; diaconia line 018 328 301. Other local parish contacts are listed on the official fund page.

accepted_services.name: Rädda Barnen på Åland – Barnfonden
coverage_verified: All 16 Åland municipalities; all are selectable in the current application form
accepted_services.location: Köpmansgatan 10, 22100 Mariehamn; applications can be submitted electronically or on paper.
accepted_services.regular_time: Applications are processed continuously during the year; the organisation aims to reply within one month. The office may be closed and no grants made during holidays and school breaks.
accepted_services.free_and_conditions: Free grant support for children aged 0–17 and their families in financial hardship or temporary crisis. Examples include hobby and leisure fees, hobby equipment, birthday celebrations and special experiences. Each application is assessed individually according to the child's needs and the fund's available resources; an application does not guarantee a grant. The fund generally does not replace goods or services that municipalities or the state are legally required to provide.

accepted_services.regular_time: Applications can be submitted continuously during the year. The application must be approved before the adaptation work begins; a home visit is arranged if the eligibility criteria are met.
